'''Rowan Hurn''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident who is on the [[Village Council]].

== Activities ==
He is part of the Village Council, which is in session when [[Padan Fain]] arrives.

He is now a part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army. Perrin sends him to check if the [[Whitecloak]]s have released the captives they have taken during Perrin's trial.
